Master Manipulation

By: Joy Summers | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Two dedicated civil servants in the Master’s office are being hounded out of their jobs by powerful shadowy interests. One has already left.

Unique Selling Point:
Unique story and exclusive interview with the recently resigned Deputy Master at a time when the masters office is in disarray. Important story that shows that the very thing that the Zondo commission has highlighted at SARS is now happening at the masters office.

Summary:
SUMMARY
Christine Rossouw has spent most of her working life at the masters office in Pretoria.
She has overseen the liquidations of PRASA, AURORA, VBS, BOSASA. A hostile portfolio of cases where it’s much easier to make enemies than friends, especially if you are trying to do the right thing.

In August 2021 as the Deputy Master in Gauteng, she was slapped with a notice to suspend her. It was so clearly a manufactured smear campaign to get her out, that she decided she was too tired to fight it internally and she has resigned and will continue fighting it from the outside.

Her boss Tessie Bezuidenhout was the acting master and chief director, and she too has been suspended but on different but no less nefarious charges. But Bezuidenhout is not going without a fight.

Both women allege that the suspension letters came on the back of a summons from the Bosasa liquidator to the ANC for an unlawful donation of R3 million rand. They believe that the only inference that can be drawn is that the justice minister is trying to protect ANC politicians as the Bosasa matter will end up in a 417 inquiry that can expose the rot and recommend prosecutions. Neither of these women will back down in the face of political pressure. Bezuidenhout appointed Cloete Murray as the liquidator on Bosasa after SARS requested her to do so because Bosasa was destroying evidence. SARS had an R800 million rand claim and were the biggest claimant. But what has the Bosasa matter got to do with their suspension and how do they make the leap that the masters office is being captured and they are in the way?



Further information:
Because It is only the master who can appoint liquidators and remove them. Ever since Cloete Murray was appointed as a liquidator for Bosasa the Watsons who put their companies into voluntary liquidation in 2019, have been trying to remove him. The Watson’s had hoped when they put the company into voluntary liquidation because the banks were about to close their accounts, they would get a compliant liquidator. They didn’t – they got bulldog Cloete instead, and even though they went to court to remove him, and almost got away with it, the SCA wagged their finger from Bloemfontein, overturned a highly suspicious judgement in the Johannesburg high court and said that Cloete must stay.


Currently Martin Mafojane is the new master and they say doing the bidding of justice Minister Ronald Lamola. According to their sources Mafojane was called and told to apply on the third round of interviews for the job of chief master. There were two highly capable women within the organisation who had applied but were pushed aside. Now Mafojane is in charge.

THE MOTALA SUB PLOT.
At the time we did the 417 Aurora inquiry Enver Motala was closely allied to the Zuma’s. He is not an honest liquidator and through the actions of Mike Tshishonga who opposed Enver Motala’s appointment in a billion rand liquidation matter, he stood on the toes of the then minister of Justice Penuel Maduna. Exactly what is happening to Christine Rossouw happened to Tshishonga. They pushed him out, he fought and won, was reinstated and given a back office with nothing to do. Eventually he left and has been trying to find a political home ever since eventually landing at Action SA. He says Rossouw made huge changes to clean up the master’s office and he speaks of her in glowing terms. He didn’t know she had been suspended and when I quiz him on the possible Enver Motala comeback, he says if Ronald Lamola does that, he will lose all respect he has for the justice minister. Tshishonga is happy to go on camera.

Both Tshishonga and Rossouw bear the scars of taking on powerful politicians.
The disgraced Enver Motala who may have a reason to feel vengeful against Rossouw has been trying to get back onto the liquidation panel. The courts wouldn’t let him back but now it seems that Mafojane might once again open the gates for him.

TRUMPED UP CHARGES
The charges against the Rossouw relate to an SIU investigation of the masters office in which it is alleged that Rossouw failed to mention that she added a liquidators name to a certificate. The facts have been twisted to make it appear that she was hiding information but it seems unlikely that these facts will stand scrutiny as Rossouw has all the documents proving her innocence.

Carte Blanche goes in search of answers.

FINAL SCRIPT MASTER MANIPULATION SCRIPT TO LENGTH TX 24th APRIL 2022

Commentary One
This tall building in downtown Pretoria is home to the Department of Justice. Under its leadership is the masters office where deceased, insolvent estates, and trusts are processed.

It may sound boringly administrative, but what happens inside these walls is anything but,
because events overseen by the masters office involve billions of Rands, and are of great interest to politicians.

Mike
I was pushed out without having done anything wrong.

Commentary Two
Mike Tshishonga, a former deputy Director General in charge of the masters office in 2003, defied his minister, took a stand against corruption, and paid a price

MIKE
I can't be allowed to continue in the department because the minister or whoever will not get his way. Now there comes the trumped up charges..

Commentary three
Mike Tshishonga was suspended and disciplined for blowing the whistle. He fought and won at the Labour court, and returned to his office in downtown Pretoria

Mike
In my case, they said, okay, fine, let him go to the office. have you have your PA, your computer? but no work will come to you, so I made myself busy by writing a book. The book is called The Whistle Blower.

Commentary Four
Eventually Mike won his constructive dismissal case, but both he and his wife Cecilia were pushed out of their respective roles as civil servants

Mike
From 2003 I felt my life has never been the same again. I was told that I will never get a job in South Africa. I thought it was a joke. It’s True. So life was very, very difficult.

Up sound Cecilia Tshishonga
Tea, tea, you always want more tea ...



Commentary Five
Before he left the justice department, Mike appointed Christene Rossouw as an assistant master. Now as her career comes to a close, what happened to Mike, is repeating itself almost 20 years later

Christene
I worked very late at night. I did so many projects, I was involved in training.
I always believe in the good of other people, and it's disappointing, it is disturbing to be treated this way at the end of my career

Commentary six
For more than 33 years the masters office was a huge part Christene Rossouw’s life. And she rose to the position of deputy master in charge of liquidations

Bongani
Powerful Position?
Christene
I would say so, because you make decisions on appointments of liquidators

Commentary seven
The masters office is the sole government agency that can appoint and remove liquidators.
And that is important because as companies fold it’s up to a diligent liquidator to recover money and report any criminality. VBS bank is one such example

Bongani
So a company essentially, is very naked in front of liquidators?
Christene
Yes. Liquidators who do their job properly.

Commentary eight
But not all liquidators do. A friendly liquidator may look the other way, so it’s up to civil servants like Christene to ensure that liquidators do their jobs without fear or favour.

But some of the companies that fold have ties to powerful interests and
there are money trails that those in high office may prefer to keep hidden


John Walker
Now if you control the master you control the liquidator, because in terms of law the master can direct the liquidator what to do.

Commentary nine
John Walker is Christene Rossouw’s attorney

Bongani
John, can you give me an idea of the kind of power that resides in the master's office?
John Walker
Most of these perpetrators of state capture that we have seen have conducted the affairs through companies, when these companies are liquidated, then the master takes over. And by implication, the liquidator takes over. Now in my experience the only people who investigate corporate fraud are liquidators.

Commentary Ten
Christene has presided over the liquidations of some of State Capture’s most criminal companies

AURORA MINERS CHANT

In 2012 when we first met Rossouw and attorney John Walker at at an inquiry into Aurora gold mine- stripped by its directors, it led to miners starving and the mine closing down.

Zondwa Mandela, Jacob Zuma’s nephew Khulubuse Zuma and his lawyer were at the centre of this embarrassing scandal.

Later her toxic portfolio included the liquidation of PRASA divisions, VBS bank, and more recently two central state capture liquidations Trillion and Bosasa

Bongani
Ultimately, she has presided over matters with a lot of political heat?
Absolutely
Would that then make Christine Rossouw a target?
John Walker
Christine has been a target for quite some time.

Up sound Gavin Watson
1 2 3 4 ....

Commentary eleven
Over 17 years Bosasa grew into a giant of a company. Gavin Watson was the man at the helm and South Africans may remember this footage of him counting out cash for bribes

Up sound Gavin Watson: R1 million my brother

Virtually all their wealth came from government contracts – they manipulated tenders, paid millions in bribes, built houses for prison bosses. The NPA, ministers -current and former, Bosasa’s corruption was on an industrial scale. And when the SIU began to dig around, the company destroyed evidence, and brought the investigation to a standstill

Up sound Agrizzi
We got the petrol and we poured it over the items, lit it and burnt everything

Commentary twelve
But in early 2019 Bosasa’s former COO Angelo Agrizzi took the stand at the Zondo Commission and told all. The party was over

By then the directors had renamed Bosasa to African global. They hastily placed it into voluntary liquidation, hoping to control the process- but that’s not how things work

John Walker
You must understand one thing Bongani, when a company or a person gets liquidated, all of the assets and money immediately vests in the office of the Master from that point in time,
Its only when the master appoints a liquidator that the assets move over to the liquidator, but it doesn’t become his personal assets he must administer that process under the supervision of the master and according to the law.

Commentary thirteen
But before a liquidator was appointed, SARS the company’s biggest creditor, heard that once again evidence was being destroyed

Up sound evidence burning

So they asked the masters office in Pretoria to move quickly and appoint their preferred liquidator- Cloete Murray

Bongani
You literally rocked up there with chains and locks?
Cloete Murray
We did. We arrived there unannounced. We established where all the documents were kept, keep in mind there were rumours of documents being destroyed.

Commentary fourteen
The liquidators team worked the entire weekend to download the server information and saved most of it

Bongani
Was there any evidence of an attempt to destroy information?
Cloete Murray
Correct there was. There was a wholesale burning of documents confirmed by those employees who did that.



LINK
From the moment Cloete Murray was appointed as the Bosasa liquidator, there have been concerted efforts to get rid of him.

Commentary fifteen
The acting chief master Tessie Bezuidenhout had recommended Cloete Murray’s appointment, and Christene was the custodian of the Bosasa file. Suddenly all three of them became targets of a campaign to remove them – and Murray fought a court battle right up to the Supreme Court of appeal- which gave judgement he could stay on.

Cloete Murray
They had what I would describe as a planned liquidation. But ya I was appointed which was not part of their bigger plan


Commentary sixteen
Murray is not a popular guy. He has been conducting a 417 inquiry -it’s a confidential but powerful tool in the hands liquidators to recover money, establish director liability and recover debts. A final 417 report is often dynamite

Bongani
A lot of the people who have been implicated in the state capture commission, even when they accept they received benefits from Bosasa, they will say hang on there is no smoking gun, the 417 inquiry removes that doubt?
Cloete Murray
It does! It opens the door to the cupboard with all the smoking guns!

Commentary seventeen
Then in July last year one of those smoking guns went off here at Luthuli House.

Bosasa had donated R3.6 million rand to the ANC and the liquidators sent a summons to pay back the money.

Within weeks it had found its way to the DOJ and that's what was used to suspend Christene Rossouw...

John Walker
The grounds for the suspension is that she would interfere with the investigation on who knows what grounds and secondly, that she would intimidate witnesses working for the state. This simply doesn't make sense to me.




Commentary eighteen
Christene waited but was never charged. The department said she omitted to tell the SIU about an amended certificate of appointment on Bosasa. But she had done so on the instructions of a court order


Bongani
So who suspended you?
Christene
when I asked the person who brought my suspension letter he told me it’s the department
Bongani
Hang on you are working in the masters office, you are in a sense having oversight on some of the most politically charged, certainly high profile liquidations and some nameless faceless person can remove you?!
Christene
Yes apparently
Bongani
Does it suggest to you, then that powerful interests wanted you out of the way?
Christene
It definitely does. And the fact that I am not given a name to link to my suspension is even more suspicious to me.

LINK
How many times have we seen this playbook, an investigation into the affairs of powerful interests and a public official just doing their jobs, but they are in the way- and so they have to go

Commentary nineteen
Acting chief master Tessie Bezuidenhout was also suspended. She was charged for over extending her powers to recommend Cloete Murray’s appointment even though an SCA ruling found she had done nothing wrong.

John Walker
But for the swift action of these two officials who have now been suspended, I don't think anybody would have realized the extent of what has happened in Bosasa
Bongani
So now you've got an attempt to remove one of the liquidators who has that information and an attempt to remove the senior official in the master's office who appointed the liquidators.
John Walker: That is correct. that is where we are right now.

Commentary twenty
We sent a long list of questions to the Justice department but were met with silence

Cloete Murray
I think the Bosasa matter is being used as an excuse to get rid of these two people
Bongani
Is this just about Bosasa?
Cloete
It’s not, it’s much bigger than Bosasa. Keep in mind that a lot of entities that benefitted from state capture might go into liquidation, all of these companies need to be investigated and if you control the masters office you can ensure from a political point of view that a liquidator is appointed that don’t ask the questions

Commentary twenty one
Is that the reason for the sustained campaign against Murray, Rossouw and Bezuidenhout? Why is it that the department of justice is trying so hard to get rid of its senior officals? And now it seems that an unrehabilitated insolvent is being used to carry out the smear...

Link
Enter Mario Rocha! A failed businessman who calls himself the slayer of liquidators but curiously he has access to confidential information that absolutely has nothing to do with him.

Bongani
Insofar as it pertains to your matters, what's your problem with Cloete Murray?
Mario Rocha
He's a corrupt colluding racketeering liquidator.

Commentary Twenty two
Cloete Murray has liquidated two of Mario Rocha’s companies. He also has an interim court order against Rocha to bar him from defaming him, which didn’t stop Rocha.

Rocha
We weren't liquidated in terms of the law. We were liquidated in terms of Cloete Murray’s law.
Bongani
Is he that powerful?
Mario Rocha
Well, why is it that nobody's ever taken him on and come out successfully? Because he controls the courts, he is that powerful because why? He was made that by those two individuals Tessie Bezuidenhout and Christene Rossouw
Bongani
What are you accusing Rossouw and Bezuidenhout of?
Mario Rocha
I am accusing them of not following the law and following the process in terms of the appointment of liquidators?



John Walker
Before there was any publication of the suspension of Mrs Rossouw or Mrs Bezuidenhout, Rocha addressed an email to all and sundry recording that they would be suspended. Now, my first and logical question to you would be, how did he know that?

Bongani
But how did you know?
Mario Rocha
Um, through the various people that have informed me..
Bongani
Who are those individuals? Who told you?
Mario Rocha
I cannot divulge that, but I'll tell you that I am witness number one in this country against this colluding...
Bongani
You're an ordinary member of the public. These are senior officials in the Masters office, and you had information that they would be suspended. How?
Mario Rocha
This is a great country, people have got freedom of speech so if someone comes to you and says this is what is happening
Bongani
Who’s that somebody?!
Mario
Officials that are sitting for example in the SIU.
Bongani
Someone From the SIU told you they would be suspended from the master's office?
Mario Rocha
Correct.

Commentary 24
In 2020 the SIU began to investigate serious maladministration in the masters office. Rossouw and Bezuidenhout answered their questions, but the SIU aren’t answering ours. Like, are its officials leaking confidential information to Mario Rocha?

Cloete Murray
I definitely get the idea that Mr. Rocha is not working by himself
Bongani
Could he be a pawn in a game that is much bigger than he is
Cloete
Ya most certainly can ya.

Commentary 25
In the end Christene resigned – she saw what had been done to Mike Tshishonga and has decided to sue the department like he did, for constructive dismissal.
Bongani
Ntata Mike you left officially in 2005
Mike
Yes.
Bongani
Here we in 2022, talking about the same things. What does that say to you?
Mike
I'm not surprised, because there is a lot of money in the liquidation.

Bongani
Did they win? The bad guys here.
Christene
I think they are trying to. I don't know if they will, in the end.

Commentary 27
The department never did answer our questions, Tessie Bezuidenhout is currently facing them down in a lengthy disciplinary hearing, and Cloete Murray lives to fight another day.

THE END

PROMO ONE 11 sec.
The Zondo commission is done, but is State Capture is over? Recent events at the masters office - under the department of justice suggest it's anything but...

PROMO TWO

Voice over
Two senior officials in the masters office in charge of high profile liquidations were recently suspended.
Bongani
Did they win? The bad guys here.
Christene
I think they are trying to. I don't know if they will, in the end.
Voice over
Shadowy forces and trumped up charges in the Bosasa liquidation

PROMO THREE

Voice over
Ever since Cloete Murray – the Bosasa liquidator was appointed, there have been attempts from several quarters to get rid of him
Bongani
Is this just about Bosasa?
Cloete
It’s not, it’s much bigger than Bosasa. Keep in mind that the state capturer related matters Bosasa is one. It’s important for the state capturers to try and gain control over the process.

Commentary nine John Walker is Christene Rossouw’s attorney Bongani John, can you give me an idea of the kind of power that resides in the master's office? John Walker Most of these perpetrators of state capture that we have seen have conducted the affairs through companies, when these companies are liquidated, then the master takes over. And by implication, the liquidator takes over. Now in my experience the only people who investigate corporate fraud are liquidators. Commentary Ten Christene has presided over the liquidations of some of State Capture’s most criminal companies AURORA MINERS CHANT In 2012 when we first met Rossouw and attorney John Walker at at an inquiry into Aurora gold mine- stripped by its directors, it led to miners starving and the mine closing down. Zondwa Mandela, Jacob Zuma’s nephew Khulubuse Zuma and his lawyer were at the centre of this embarrassing scandal. Later her toxic portfolio included the liquidation of PRASA divisions, VBS bank, and more recently two central state capture liquidations Trillion and Bosasa Bongani Ultimately, she has presided over matters with a lot of political heat? Absolutely Would that then make Christine Rossouw a target? John Walker Christine has been a target for quite some time. Up sound Gavin Watson 1 2 3 4 .... Commentary eleven Over 17 years Bosasa grew into a giant of a company. Gavin Watson was the man at the helm and South Africans may remember this footage of him counting out cash for bribes Up sound Gavin Watson: R1 million my brother Virtually all their wealth came from government contracts – they manipulated tenders, paid millions in bribes, built houses for prison bosses. The NPA, ministers -current and former, Bosasa’s corruption was on an industrial scale. And when the SIU began to dig around, the company destroyed evidence, and brought the investigation to a standstill Up sound Agrizzi We got the petrol and we poured it over the items, lit it and burnt everything Commentary twelve But in early 2019 Bosasa’s former COO Angelo Agrizzi took the stand at the Zondo Commission and told all. The party was over By then the directors had renamed Bosasa to African global. They hastily placed it into voluntary liquidation, hoping to control the process- but that’s not how things work John Walker You must understand one thing Bongani, when a company or a person gets liquidated, all of the assets and money immediately vests in the office of the Master from that point in time, Its only when the master appoints a liquidator that the assets move over to the liquidator, but it doesn’t become his personal assets he must administer that process under the supervision of the master and according to the law. Commentary thirteen But before a liquidator was appointed, SARS the company’s biggest creditor, heard that once again evidence was being destroyed Up sound evidence burning So they asked the masters office in Pretoria to move quickly and appoint their preferred liquidator- Cloete Murray Bongani You literally rocked up there with chains and locks? Cloete Murray We did. We arrived there unannounced. We established where all the documents were kept, keep in mind there were rumours of documents being destroyed. Commentary fourteen The liquidators team worked the entire weekend to download the server information and saved most of it Bongani Was there any evidence of an attempt to destroy information? Cloete Murray Correct there was. There was a wholesale burning of documents confirmed by those employees who did that. LINK From the moment Cloete Murray was appointed as the Bosasa liquidator, there have been concerted efforts to get rid of him. Commentary fifteen The acting chief master Tessie Bezuidenhout had recommended Cloete Murray’s appointment, and Christene was the custodian of the Bosasa file. Suddenly all three of them became targets of a campaign to remove them – and Murray fought a court battle right up to the Supreme Court of appeal- which gave judgement he could stay on. Cloete Murray They had what I would describe as a planned liquidation. But ya I was appointed which was not part of their bigger plan Commentary sixteen Murray is not a popular guy. He has been conducting a 417 inquiry -it’s a confidential but powerful tool in the hands liquidators to recover money, establish director liability and recover debts. A final 417 report is often dynamite Bongani A lot of the people who have been implicated in the state capture commission, even when they accept they received benefits from Bosasa, they will say hang on there is no smoking gun, the 417 inquiry removes that doubt? Cloete Murray It does! It opens the door to the cupboard with all the smoking guns! Commentary seventeen Then in July last year one of those smoking guns went off here at Luthuli House. Bosasa had donated R3.6 million rand to the ANC and the liquidators sent a summons to pay back the money. Within weeks it had found its way to the DOJ and that's what was used to suspend Christene Rossouw... John Walker The grounds for the suspension is that she would interfere with the investigation on who knows what grounds and secondly, that she would intimidate witnesses working for the state. This simply doesn't make sense to me. Commentary eighteen Christene waited but was never charged. The department said she omitted to tell the SIU about an amended certificate of appointment on Bosasa. But she had done so on the instructions of a court order Bongani So who suspended you? Christene when I asked the person who brought my suspension letter he told me it’s the department Bongani Hang on you are working in the masters office, you are in a sense having oversight on some of the most politically charged, certainly high profile liquidations and some nameless faceless person can remove you?! Christene Yes apparently Bongani Does it suggest to you, then that powerful interests wanted you out of the way? Christene It definitely does. And the fact that I am not given a name to link to my suspension is even more suspicious to me. LINK How many times have we seen this playbook, an investigation into the affairs of powerful interests and a public official just doing their jobs, but they are in the way- and so they have to go Commentary nineteen Acting chief master Tessie Bezuidenhout was also suspended. She was charged for over extending her powers to recommend Cloete Murray’s appointment even though an SCA ruling found she had done nothing wrong. John Walker But for the swift action of these two officials who have now been suspended, I don't think anybody would have realized the extent of what has happened in Bosasa Bongani So now you've got an attempt to remove one of the liquidators who has that information and an attempt to remove the senior official in the master's office who appointed the liquidators. John Walker: That is correct. that is where we are right now. Commentary twenty We sent a long list of questions to the Justice department but were met with silence Cloete Murray I think the Bosasa matter is being used as an excuse to get rid of these two people Bongani Is this just about Bosasa? Cloete It’s not, it’s much bigger than Bosasa. Keep in mind that a lot of entities that benefitted from state capture might go into liquidation, all of these companies need to be investigated and if you control the masters office you can ensure from a political point of view that a liquidator is appointed that don’t ask the questions Commentary twenty one Is that the reason for the sustained campaign against Murray, Rossouw and Bezuidenhout? Why is it that the department of justice is trying so hard to get rid of its senior officals? And now it seems that an unrehabilitated insolvent is being used to carry out the smear... Link Enter Mario Rocha! A failed businessman who calls himself the slayer of liquidators but curiously he has access to confidential information that absolutely has nothing to do with him. Bongani Insofar as it pertains to your matters, what's your problem with Cloete Murray? Mario Rocha He's a corrupt colluding racketeering liquidator. Commentary Twenty two Cloete Murray has liquidated two of Mario Rocha’s companies. He also has an interim court order against Rocha to bar him from defaming him, which didn’t stop Rocha. Rocha We weren't liquidated in terms of the law. We were liquidated in terms of Cloete Murray’s law. Bongani Is he that powerful? Mario Rocha Well, why is it that nobody's ever taken him on and come out successfully? Because he controls the courts, he is that powerful because why? He was made that by those two individuals Tessie Bezuidenhout and Christene Rossouw Bongani What are you accusing Rossouw and Bezuidenhout of? Mario Rocha I am accusing them of not following the law and following the process in terms of the appointment of liquidators? John Walker Before there was any publication of the suspension of Mrs Rossouw or Mrs Bezuidenhout, Rocha addressed an email to all and sundry recording that they would be suspended. Now, my first and logical question to you would be, how did he know that? Bongani But how did you know? Mario Rocha Um, through the various people that have informed me.. Bongani Who are those individuals? Who told you? Mario Rocha I cannot divulge that, but I'll tell you that I am witness number one in this country against this colluding... Bongani You're an ordinary member of the public. These are senior officials in the Masters office, and you had information that they would be suspended. How? Mario Rocha This is a great country, people have got freedom of speech so if someone comes to you and says this is what is happening Bongani Who’s that somebody?! Mario Officials that are sitting for example in the SIU. Bongani Someone From the SIU told you they would be suspended from the master's office? Mario Rocha Correct. Commentary 24 In 2020 the SIU began to investigate serious maladministration in the masters office. Rossouw and Bezuidenhout answered their questions, but the SIU aren’t answering ours. Like, are its officials leaking confidential information to Mario Rocha? Cloete Murray I definitely get the idea that Mr. Rocha is not working by himself Bongani Could he be a pawn in a game that is much bigger than he is Cloete Ya most certainly can ya. Commentary 25 In the end Christene resigned – she saw what had been done to Mike Tshishonga and has decided to sue the department like he did, for constructive dismissal. Bongani Ntata Mike you left officially in 2005 Mike Yes. Bongani Here we in 2022, talking about the same things. What does that say to you? Mike I'm not surprised, because there is a lot of money in the liquidation. Bongani Did they win? The bad guys here. Christene I think they are trying to. I don't know if they will, in the end. Commentary 27 The department never did answer our questions, Tessie Bezuidenhout is currently facing them down in a lengthy disciplinary hearing, and Cloete Murray lives to fight another day. THE END PROMO ONE 11 sec. The Zondo commission is done, but is State Capture is over? Recent events at the masters office - under the department of justice suggest it's anything but... PROMO TWO Voice over Two senior officials in the masters office in charge of high profile liquidations were recently suspended. Bongani Did they win? The bad guys here. Christene I think they are trying to. I don't know if they will, in the end. Voice over Shadowy forces and trumped up charges in the Bosasa liquidation PROMO THREE Voice over Ever since Cloete Murray – the Bosasa liquidator was appointed, there have been attempts from several quarters to get rid of him Bongani Is this just about Bosasa? Cloete It’s not, it’s much bigger than Bosasa. Keep in mind that the state capturer related matters Bosasa is one. It’s important for the state capturers to try and gain control over the process. metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Two dedicated civil servants in the Master’s office are being hounded out of their jobs by powerful shadowy interests. One has already left.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: Unique story and exclusive interview with the recently resigned Deputy Master at a time when the masters office is in disarray. Important story that shows that the very thing that the Zondo commission has highlighted at SARS is now happening at the masters office.
metadata.Summary: SUMMARY Christine Rossouw has spent most of her working life at the masters office in Pretoria. She has overseen the liquidations of PRASA, AURORA, VBS, BOSASA. A hostile portfolio of cases where it’s much easier to make enemies than friends, especially if you are trying to do the right thing. In August 2021 as the Deputy Master in Gauteng, she was slapped with a notice to suspend her. It was so clearly a manufactured smear campaign to get her out, that she decided she was too tired to fight it internally and she has resigned and will continue fighting it from the outside. Her boss Tessie Bezuidenhout was the acting master and chief director, and she too has been suspended but on different but no less nefarious charges. But Bezuidenhout is not going without a fight. Both women allege that the suspension letters came on the back of a summons from the Bosasa liquidator to the ANC for an unlawful donation of R3 million rand. They believe that the only inference that can be drawn is that the justice minister is trying to protect ANC politicians as the Bosasa matter will end up in a 417 inquiry that can expose the rot and recommend prosecutions. Neither of these women will back down in the face of political pressure. Bezuidenhout appointed Cloete Murray as the liquidator on Bosasa after SARS requested her to do so because Bosasa was destroying evidence. SARS had an R800 million rand claim and were the biggest claimant. But what has the Bosasa matter got to do with their suspension and how do they make the leap that the masters office is being captured and they are in the way?
metadata.Further information: Because It is only the master who can appoint liquidators and remove them. Ever since Cloete Murray was appointed as a liquidator for Bosasa the Watsons who put their companies into voluntary liquidation in 2019, have been trying to remove him. The Watson’s had hoped when they put the company into voluntary liquidation because the banks were about to close their accounts, they would get a compliant liquidator. They didn’t – they got bulldog Cloete instead, and even though they went to court to remove him, and almost got away with it, the SCA wagged their finger from Bloemfontein, overturned a highly suspicious judgement in the Johannesburg high court and said that Cloete must stay. Currently Martin Mafojane is the new master and they say doing the bidding of justice Minister Ronald Lamola. According to their sources Mafojane was called and told to apply on the third round of interviews for the job of chief master. There were two highly capable women within the organisation who had applied but were pushed aside. Now Mafojane is in charge. THE MOTALA SUB PLOT. At the time we did the 417 Aurora inquiry Enver Motala was closely allied to the Zuma’s. He is not an honest liquidator and through the actions of Mike Tshishonga who opposed Enver Motala’s appointment in a billion rand liquidation matter, he stood on the toes of the then minister of Justice Penuel Maduna. Exactly what is happening to Christine Rossouw happened to Tshishonga. They pushed him out, he fought and won, was reinstated and given a back office with nothing to do. Eventually he left and has been trying to find a political home ever since eventually landing at Action SA. He says Rossouw made huge changes to clean up the master’s office and he speaks of her in glowing terms. He didn’t know she had been suspended and when I quiz him on the possible Enver Motala comeback, he says if Ronald Lamola does that, he will lose all respect he has for the justice minister. Tshishonga is happy to go on camera. Both Tshishonga and Rossouw bear the scars of taking on powerful politicians. The disgraced Enver Motala who may have a reason to feel vengeful against Rossouw has been trying to get back onto the liquidation panel. The courts wouldn’t let him back but now it seems that Mafojane might once again open the gates for him. TRUMPED UP CHARGES The charges against the Rossouw relate to an SIU investigation of the masters office in which it is alleged that Rossouw failed to mention that she added a liquidators name to a certificate. The facts have been twisted to make it appear that she was hiding information but it seems unlikely that these facts will stand scrutiny as Rossouw has all the documents proving her innocence. Carte Blanche goes in search of answers.
